## Purpose

Cloudflare Tunnel exposing the cache sync service (prod only).

## Dockerfile

`apps/cloudflared/Dockerfile` — `debian:trixie-20230612` with `cloudflared` installed. Entrypoint: `apps/cloudflared/entrypoint.sh`.

## Entrypoint

Reads `TUNNEL_TOKEN` from `$TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE` secret (using the Docker secret → env pattern), runs `cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate run --token "$TUNNEL_TOKEN"`.

## Docker Compose

Prod-only in `docker-compose.prod.yml`. Uses `wywywebsite-cache-cloudflared-cloudflare` secret from `${SECRETS_DIR}/cache/cloudflared-cloudflare-token.txt`. Network: `cloudflared`.
